## Summary

Describe the focused change and the user or contributor problem it solves.

## Scope

- Related issue:
- Roadmap phase:
- Areas changed:

## Validation

Explain how the change was tested. Include hardware details for model-dependent work.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to one concern.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/check_repo.py`.
- [ ] Tests or deterministic fixtures cover the change where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation was updated.
- [ ] No model weights, secrets, or private assets are included.
- [ ] New model/workflow dependencies include source, version, license, hardware, and restrictions.
- [ ] Architecture or format changes include an ADR or migration plan.
- [ ] The change preserves prior assets when an operation fails or is cancelled.

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots or a short recording for UI changes. Mark conceptual mockups clearly.
